messages.subject: nested tabPanels
parts:
Hello All!

I am a new Shiny user.
I was attempting to make nested tabPanels.
The tabPanels appear (see attached plot) but not the outputs.

Do you know how to specify the good "destination" for the outputs and where (in ui.R, server.R)?


ui.R

mainPanel(
    tabsetPanel(
      tabPanel("Data",dataTableOutput("mytable"),value = 1),
      tabPanel("Number of cases",
          tabsetPanel(
             tabPanel("Daily",plotOutput("cases"), value = 2),
             tabPanel("Weekly",plotOutput("cases"), value = 3),
             id = "CasesPanel"
              )
              ),
      tabPanel("Epidemic curve",plotOutput("epidemic"), value = 4),
      tabPanel("Nowcasting",plotOutput("nowcast"), value = 5),
      tabPanel("Delays",plotOutput("delays"), value = 6),
      id = "MainPanel"
    )
  )


Please let me know if I can provide additional information.

Thank you very much!

Yann

parts:
Hello,

I tried to find an answer to my own question but without success. 
Does someone can help me and tell me what's wrong in my ui.R file? I just want to include multiple panels in one panel... 
The plot does not appear.
I'm sorry if my question is basic but I'm really stuck.
Thanks a lot for your help
Yann 

ui.R
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel("Epidemic"),
  sidebarPanel(p(strong("Epidemic curve"))
  ),

mainPanel(
   tabsetPanel(
        tabPanel("A",
           tabsetPanel(
             tabPanel("A1",plotOutput("epidemic")),
             tabPanel("A2",plotOutput("epidemic"))
           )
           ),
        tabPanel("B",
           tabsetPanel(
             tabPanel("B1",plotOutput("epidemic")),
             tabPanel("B2",plotOutput("epidemic"))
           )
        )
          )
          )
))


server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {

output$epidemic <- renderPlot({
plot(c(1:10),c(1:10))
})
    
})
